name: MarsCon
blurb: The largest sci-fi/fantasy convention in Virginia's Tidewater area, with author, gaming, music and cosplay guests.

editions.evidence: Homepage: 'MarsCon 2027... Meet the MarsCon 2027 Guests of Honor'; hotel booking link's $99/night MarsCon group-code rate 'valid through 1/9/2027' (consistent with a mid-January con, not the unconfirmed February reading of an earlier hotel-widget check)
